topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't help but wander back to that corner seat, the one by the window where the light makes everything taste just a bit sweeter. They say the plates will stop spinning, the kitchen will fall silent, and the door will close for the last time. How can this place, which has always felt like a haven, simply... cease? I find myself trailing back here, as if my steps alone could summon the warmth of those kitchen lights, the raucous laughter spilling from tables. Maybe if I come often enough, if I sit just so, it will all be a misstep, a miscalculation. Because the thought of it not being here—well, that’s a meal I’m not prepared to swallow.
